entries.title: Your crew can make and update Google Docs and Sheets
entries.body: The Google row now adds Docs and Sheets. Your crew can create a doc from text with headings, lists and links, add to a doc and replace words in it, read a sheet's tabs and cells, create a sheet, set cells and add rows. Each change starts out asking you first, and Allow for the rest of this task covers one doc or one sheet. No action deletes, moves or shares a file. Turn on the Docs and Sheets MCP services in your Google Cloud project if they are off.
